source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 11 (PDF 205-222), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Trigonometric Functions and their Graphs) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Using the unit circle, find the domain and the range of \(\sin\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\). Hence explain why \(2\cos\theta = 3\) has no solution. (5 marks)
(Unit circle ki madad se \(\sin\theta\) aur \(\cos\theta\) ka domain aur range nikalein. Phir batayein ke \(2\cos\theta = 3\) ka koi hal kyun nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) ko terminal point ke coordinates samjhein, phir \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Every point of the unit circle satisfies

steps: \(\theta\) ka terminal side unit circle ko \(P(x, y)\) par mile; \(\cos\theta = x\), \(\sin\theta = y\)
Har real \(\theta\) ke liye aik hi point, is liye domain dono ka \(\mathbb{R}\)
\(\pm 1\) axis points par milte hain: range dono ki \([-1, 1]\)
\(\cos\theta = \frac{3}{2} > 1\) chahiye jo range se bahar hai: koi hal nahi

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the domain and the range of \(\tan\theta\) and of \(\cot\theta\), giving reasons. List the excluded angles in \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\) for each. (5 marks)
(\(\tan\theta\) aur \(\cot\theta\) ka domain aur range wajah ke saath nikalein. \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\) mein har aik ke khaarij angles likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ko \(P(x, y)\) ke coordinates ki fraction likhein aur denominator sifar wale angles nikaal dein.

book_ref.quote: therefore the range of tangent function

blocks.prompt:
3 Find the domain and the range of \(\sec\theta\). Hence decide whether \(\sec\theta = -\frac{1}{2}\) and \(\sec\theta = -\frac{5}{2}\) are possible. (5 marks)
(\(\sec\theta\) ka domain aur range nikalein. Phir faisla karein ke \(\sec\theta = -\frac{1}{2}\) aur \(\sec\theta = -\frac{5}{2}\) mumkin hain ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\); \(0 < x \le 1\) aur \(-1 \le x < 0\) ke reciprocals lein.

book_ref.quote: Dividing \(1\) by a positive number that is at most

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the domain and the range of \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\). Hence find the values of \(k\) for which \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = k\) has a solution, and test \(k = 0.8\) and \(k = 4\). (5 marks)
(\(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) ka domain aur range nikalein. Phir \(k\) ki woh qeematein batayein jin ke liye \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = k\) ka hal hai; \(k = 0.8\) aur \(k = 4\) check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = \frac{1}{y}\), \(y \ne 0\); reciprocals lein.

book_ref.quote: attains all values except those between

blocks.prompt:
5 Determine whether each function is even, odd or neither: (i) \(f(x) = x^{2}\sin x\) (ii) \(g(x) = \dfrac{\cos x}{1 + x^{2}}\) (iii) \(h(x) = x + \cos x\). (5 marks)
(Har function even hai, odd ya dono nahi: (i) \(f(x) = x^{2}\sin x\) (ii) \(g(x) = \dfrac{\cos x}{1 + x^{2}}\) (iii) \(h(x) = x + \cos x\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein, \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\) lagayein aur muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: The graph of an odd function is always symmetric about the origin.

steps: Is liye \(h\) na even na odd

blocks.prompt:
6 Using \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\) and \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\), show that \(\tan\theta\), \(\cot\theta\) and \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) are odd and \(\sec\theta\) is even. Hence decide whether \(\sec x\tan x\) is even or odd. (5 marks)
(\(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\) aur \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\) se dikhayein ke \(\tan\theta\), \(\cot\theta\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) odd aur \(\sec\theta\) even hai. Phir batayein \(\sec x\tan x\) even hai ya odd.)
blocks.explanation: Har function ko sine aur cosine mein likh kar \(\theta\) ki jagah \(-\theta\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: The graph of an even function is always symmetric about the

blocks.prompt:
7 By the method used for the period of sine, prove that the period of \(\cos\theta\) is \(2\pi\). (5 marks)
(Sine ke period wale tareeqe se sabit karein ke \(\cos\theta\) ka period \(2\pi\) hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(p\) ko period maanein, munasib \(\theta\) rakh kar candidates nikaalein, phir sab se chhota musbat check karein.

book_ref.quote: Theorem 11.1: Sine is a periodic function

steps: \(p > 0\) period ho: har \(\theta\) ke liye \(\cos(\theta + p) = \cos\theta\) ... (C)
\(2\pi\) se chhota koi musbat \(p\) \(\cos p = 1\) nahi deta; \(\cos\pi = -1\)
\(p = 2\pi\): poora chakkar, point wapas wahi; har \(\theta\) ke liye durust
\(2\pi\) sab se chhota, is liye period \(2\pi\)

blocks.prompt:
8 By the method used for the period of tangent, prove that the period of \(\cot\theta\) is \(\pi\). Hence find the period of \(\cot 3\theta\). (5 marks)
(Tangent ke period wale tareeqe se sabit karein ke \(\cot\theta\) ka period \(\pi\) hai. Phir \(\cot 3\theta\) ka period nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakh kar candidates nikaalein; phir dikhayein ke \(\pi\) har \(\theta\) ke liye chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Theorem 11.2: Tangent is a periodic function

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the periods of (i) \(\cos 4x\) (ii) \(1 - 3\tan\frac{2x}{5}\), showing the working. (5 marks)
(Working dikha kar periods nikalein: (i) \(\cos 4x\) (ii) \(1 - 3\tan\frac{2x}{5}\).)
blocks.explanation: Angle mein basic function ka period jama karein aur use coefficient \(\times\) (\(x\) + shift) likhein.

book_ref.quote: Two conditions are packed into this definition

blocks.prompt:
10 Without a calculator, evaluate \(\sin 120^{\circ}\cos 330^{\circ} + \cos 240^{\circ}\sin(-30^{\circ})\). (5 marks)
(Calculator ke baghair qeemat nikalein: \(\sin 120^{\circ}\cos 330^{\circ} + \cos 240^{\circ}\sin(-30^{\circ})\).)
blocks.explanation: Har angle ko \(-\theta\), \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) identities se basic angle banayein.

book_ref.quote: The method is always the same three steps

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the values of all six trigonometric functions of \(225^{\circ}\), and check their signs with the quadrant. (5 marks)
(\(225^{\circ}\) ke chhe trigonometric functions ki qeematein nikalein aur quadrant se signs check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(225^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 45^{\circ}\) likh kar \(\pi + \theta\) identities lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Check every answer with the quadrant

steps: \(225^{\circ}\) Quadrant III mein, jahan sirf tangent (aur cotangent) musbat

blocks.prompt:
12 Make a table of values and draw the graph of \(y = 2\sin x\) for \(0 \le x \le 2\pi\). State its maximum and minimum values and where they occur. (5 marks)
(\(y = 2\sin x\) ka \(0 \le x \le 2\pi\) ke liye table banayein aur graph khenchein. Maximum, minimum aur un ke maqaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) ki har qeemat ko do guna karein, points plot karein aur smooth curve se milayein.

book_ref.quote: The table of the ordered pairs satisfying \(y = \sin x\) is as follows:

steps: \(x\) ko \(X\)-axis, \(y\) ko \(Y\)-axis par; points plot kar ke smooth curve
Curve \(y = 2\) aur \(y = -2\) ke darmiyan; \(x\)-axis ko \(0, \pi, 2\pi\) par kat'ta hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Make a table of values and draw the graph of \(y = 1 + \cos x\) for \(0 \le x \le 2\pi\). State its range and where it touches the \(x\)-axis. (5 marks)
(\(y = 1 + \cos x\) ka \(0 \le x \le 2\pi\) ke liye table banayein aur graph khenchein. Range aur \(x\)-axis ko chhoone ka maqaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x\) ki har qeemat mein 1 jama karein, plot karein aur smooth curve se milayein.

book_ref.quote: The table of the ordered pairs satisfying \(y = \cos x\) is as follows:

steps: Points plot kar ke smooth curve: cosine curve 1 unit upar

blocks.prompt:
14 Draw the graph of \(y = \tan x\) for \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) using the points \(0, \pm\frac{\pi}{6}, \pm\frac{\pi}{4}, \pm\frac{\pi}{3}\). Describe its behaviour near the ends. (5 marks)
(Points \(0, \pm\frac{\pi}{6}, \pm\frac{\pi}{4}, \pm\frac{\pi}{3}\) se \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) ke liye \(y = \tan x\) ka graph banayein. Kinaron ke qareeb ka rawaiyya batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Manfi angles ke liye \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\); asymptotes khenchein; points ko barhte curve se milayein.

book_ref.quote: so we shall first draw the graph for the interval from

steps: Saat points ko origin se guzarte barhte smooth curve se milayein
blocks.final_answer: \((0, 0)\) se guzarta barhta curve, asymptotes \(x = \pm\frac{\pi}{2}\); range \(\mathbb{R}\)

blocks.prompt:
15 Find the maximum and minimum values of \(f(x) = 3 - 2\sin\left(2x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\) and of its reciprocal \(\dfrac{1}{f(x)}\). Give one value of \(x\) where \(f\) is largest. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = 3 - 2\sin\left(2x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\) aur us ke reciprocal \(\dfrac{1}{f(x)}\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein nikalein. Aik \(x\) batayein jahan \(f\) sab se bara hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(M = a + |b|\), \(m = a - |b|\); \(b < 0\) mein maximum jab sine \(-1\); musbat function ka reciprocal max/min ulat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Now consider the general form of a sinusoidal function

blocks.prompt:
16 For \(y = -1 + 3\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4}x - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) find the vertical shift, the amplitude, the period, the maximum and minimum values, and the first positive \(x\) where each occurs. (5 marks)
(\(y = -1 + 3\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4}x - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) ka vertical shift, amplitude, period, maximum/minimum aur un ke pehle musbat \(x\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a + b\cos(cx + d)\) se muqabla; period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\), \(M = a + |b|\), \(m = a - |b|\).

book_ref.quote: the maximum height of the wave measured from its midline

blocks.prompt:
17 A Ferris wheel of radius 25 m has its lowest point 3 m above the ground and makes one revolution every 40 seconds. A rider gets on at the lowest point. Model the height h(t) of the rider, find the height after 25 seconds, and find when the rider first reaches the top. (5 marks)
(25 m radius wala Ferris wheel, sab se neecha point zameen se 3 m upar, har 40 seconds mein aik chakkar. Sawaar neeche se baithta hai. Height h(t) ka model banayein, 25 seconds baad height aur pehli dafa top par pohanchne ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Period se \(c\), radius se \(b\), markaz ki height se \(a\); neeche se shuru ke liye \(a - b\cos(ct)\).

book_ref.quote: Choosing the starting function: start at the top

blocks.prompt:
18 The depth of water at a harbour is \(D(t) = 7 + 3\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right)\) metres, \(t\) in hours after midnight. Find (a) the depth at \(t = 4\) (b) the greatest and least depths and when they first occur (c) the time for one full cycle. (5 marks)
(Bandargah par paani ki gehrai \(D(t) = 7 + 3\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right)\) metres, \(t\) aadhi raat ke baad ghante. (a) \(t = 4\) par gehrai (b) sab se zyada aur kam gehrai aur pehli dafa kab (c) aik poore cycle ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: (a) mein rakhein; (b) \(M = a + |b|\), \(m = a - |b|\), \(\cos = \pm 1\); (c) period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\).

book_ref.quote: The first Ferris wheel was invented by George W. Ferris

blocks.prompt:
19 At a beach the water level is highest, 14 ft, at t = 0 hours and lowest, 4 ft, at t = 6 hours, and it varies sinusoidally. Model the level L(t) and find the level at t = 2 hours and the first time after t = 6 at which it is highest again. (5 marks)
(Aik sahil par paani ki satah \(t = 0\) par sab se oonchi 14 ft aur \(t = 6\) par sab se neechi 4 ft hai, aur sinusoidal tor par badalti hai. L(t) ka model banayein, \(t = 2\) par satah aur \(t = 6\) ke baad dobara sab se oonchi hone ka pehla waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude \(\frac{M - m}{2}\), midline \(\frac{M + m}{2}\); oonchi se neechi aadha period; top se shuru \(a + b\cos(ct)\).

book_ref.quote: Every problem follows the same plan

blocks.final_answer: \(L(t) = 9 + 5\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right)\); \(L(2) = 11.5\) ft; \(t = 12\) par dobara sab se oonchi

blocks.prompt:
20 From a point 50 m above the surface of a lake, the angle of elevation of the top of a tower is \(30^{\circ}\) and the angle of depression of its image in the lake is \(45^{\circ}\). Find the height of the tower above the lake. (5 marks)
(Jheel ki satah se 50 m upar aik point se tower ki choti ka angle of elevation (zaviya-e-bulandi) \(30^{\circ}\) aur jheel mein us ke aks ka angle of depression (zaviya-e-pasti) \(45^{\circ}\) hai. Tower ki height nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Height \(h\), ufuqi faasla \(y\); aks satah se \(h\) neeche; do tangent equations likh kar \(y\) khatam karein.

book_ref.quote: the image in the water is as far below the surface as the peak is above it

steps: Choti observer se \(h - 50\) upar; aks \(50 + h\) neeche
